_comment: 'Once per Turn Action - 0' = ACTIVATE with card-level activation_cost 0 / per_turn 1; the engine charges the action point for an action-speed activation and 'Go again' refunds it at resolution from the DB keywords field (engine.py: card.has_go_again on layer resolution) - so NO explicit GAIN ACTION_POINTS here or it would double-grant. Printed Dominate likewise fires from the DB field and is not authored. 'If you do' is a CONDITIONAL gated on CARD_IN_ZONE(arsenal >= 1) wrapping the whole sequence: within one resolution nothing can empty the arsenal between the test and PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM, and PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM only no-ops on an empty arsenal, so testing before is equivalent to testing success. PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM passes player SELF explicitly - the handler DEFAULTS TO OPPONENT (that default sank sunkwater_exoshell's 'your arsenal' clause). PUT_INTO_ARSENAL(from DECK_TOP, face_up true) reports what moved as ref 'arsenaled' and leaves it unset when the deck is empty or the arsenal was full, so the arrow test (REF_IS_TYPE on 'arsenaled') correctly grants nothing in those cases. KNOWN APPROXIMATION, same one blessed in .triage/azalea.json: the grant is GRANT_KEYWORD_TO_PLAYED filtered to arrows played from arsenal this turn, not to the specific arsenaled card object - a second arrow played from arsenal later the same turn would also get dominate; per-object turn-scoped keyword grants do not exist in the DSL.
